economic_hypothesis: When the causally observable broad market and the stock's PIT industry remain healthy, a stock-specific intraday fall of at least 6% that is fully reclaimed by the completed close on expanded turnover is a temporary liquidity shock absorbed by demand, not a market-wide trend break.
entry: first legal next daily open within three market sessions
exit: target or causal H5/H10/H15 decision then next legal open
industry: PIT industry median ret20>0 and positive-ret20 share>50%

market.BEAR: both medians <= 0 AND both positive-return shares <= 0.50
market.BULL: market median ret20 > 0 AND positive-ret20 share > 0.50 AND market median ret60 > 0 AND positive-ret60 share > 0.50
market.TRANSITION: all other combinations or missing required state
market.strategy_action: trade only BULL; BEAR and TRANSITION hold cash

rules.R2_STRONG_BULL: R1 and market median ret20>=5% and breadth>=60%
rules.R3_DEEP_CLEAN_RECLAIM: R1 and panic<=-7%, close location>=80%, turnover>=1.5x

stock.cooldown: first retained signal per symbol in causal 20-session window
